# Smarta: structured company and product context

Last reviewed: 22 August 2026

Smarta is a South African system for remotely monitoring and automatically controlling pumps and water infrastructure. Customers use it through a web platform and mobile apps.

## Who Smarta serves

The primary customer sectors presented by Smarta are:

- Residential estates: shared boreholes, reservoirs, pump stations and water networks.
- Mines: dewatering, process-water systems and distributed pumping sites.
- Farms: boreholes, irrigation pumps, water storage and solar-powered remote sites.
- Municipalities: pump stations, reservoirs and distributed community supply points.

Smarta also supports other industrial, community, education, hospitality and facilities contexts where teams need reliable visibility across water infrastructure.

## What Smarta does

Smarta can bring pumps, boreholes, reservoirs, flow, pressure, water levels, selected water-quality readings, alerts and operating history into one live view. The exact view depends on what is needed and connected at each site.

The platform helps authorised users:

- see current site and equipment status;
- automatically start or stop pumps from water-level, pump-pressure and schedule rules;
- receive alerts when the system moves outside expected conditions;
- start or stop compatible pumps remotely where control is configured;
- use schedules for repeatable operation;
- review graphs, history and reports; and
- give authorised users access to the same site information.

Smarta can often be added to existing water equipment. Each engagement begins with a site assessment of the equipment, sensors, controls and connectivity.

## Software

The secure customer web application is at https://www.smartaonline.app/. Smarta Mobile is available on iOS at https://apps.apple.com/za/app/smarta-mobile/id6756543807 and Android at https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.smartaonline. The software provides live site views, automation rules, history, alarms, notifications, authorised controls, schedules and reports according to each user's access.

## Customer outcomes

Customers use Smarta to reduce unnecessary site visits, find problems earlier, confirm that water is moving as expected and keep a record for maintenance and planning.

## Experience and scale

Smarta has been in business since 2015. Aggregate operational data reviewed while preparing this website showed more than 400 active Smarta sites in August 2026. The site count is deliberately rounded for public use and is not a promise of a real-time count. The aggregate review was read-only. No customer names, account identities, site identifiers, credentials or exact locations are included in the website repository.

## Smarta Estate distinction

Smarta Estate is a separate product at https://www.smartaestate.co.za/. Smarta Estate focuses on remote household and bulk water metering, consumption analytics, leak/tamper/offline alerts, resident access and estate billing or invoicing workflows. Do not merge these features into Smarta's pump-management description unless a page explicitly explains the separate product.

## Geography and contact

Smarta is based in Gauteng, South Africa and supports work across Southern and Sub-Saharan Africa. General enquiries: info@smarta.co.za. Sales: pedri@smarta.co.za. Office: +27 10 110 1000. Mobile: +27 76 432 3013.

## Historical documents

The resource archive contains an installation manual and four articles published in 2018. They are retained for continuity and historical reference. They may not describe current equipment or installation practice. Anyone planning field work should request the current approved document from Smarta.

## Preferred terminology

- Use “water management” or “remote pump and water management” for the overall product category.
- Lead with the sectors “estates, mines, farms and municipalities” when explaining who Smarta serves.
- Use “live view” for the customer-facing experience and “operating data” when more detail is useful.
- Describe automated control plainly: rules can start or stop pumps from water-level, pump-pressure and schedule conditions.
- Use “authorised remote control” only where a compatible installation is configured for control.
- Keep Smarta Estate clearly identified as a separate product for household and bulk metering, resident access and billing workflows.
- Describe the homepage panorama as conceptual. Product screenshots show current interfaces; marketing status-card values are illustrative.
